items.t: Southwest (LUV) Up 8.5% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.sum: Southwest (LUV) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.t: LUV Expands Global Reach With French bee Interline Partnership
items.sum: Southwest Airlines expands its global reach through a French bee partnership, unlocking seamless travel to Europe, the Indian Ocean and the South Pacific.

items.t: Implied Volatility Surging for Southwest Airlines Stock Options
items.sum: Investors need to pay close attention to LUV stock based on the movements in the options market lately.

items.t: UBS Maintains Buy on Southwest Airlines, Raises Price Target to $59
items.sum: UBS analyst Atul Maheswari maintains Southwest Airlines (NYSE:LUV) with a Buy and raises the price target from $54 to $59.

items.t: Southwest Airlines is partnering with a French airline
items.sum: The interline partnership between Southwest and French bee will allow travelers from more cities to get to France on a single ticket.

items.t: Should Air Traffic Control Upgrade Support Require Action From Southwest Airlines Stock Investors?
items.sum: Southwest Airlines has affirmed a quarterly dividend of US$0.18 per share, payable on 7 January 2027, with an ex dividend and record date of 17 December 2026. Support for a larger federal air traffic control funding plan highlights how Southwest Airlines is aligning with efforts to improve operational reliability across the system.
